name: Delay
tooltip: Moves this track against the reference; minus is earlier
notes: Linear on purpose: a signed time offset. Clamped to [-Window, +200 ms]; the internal line delays by Window + Delay and the host compensates Window. Two taps, amplitude-complementary crossfade over 10 ms on a change

name: Polarity
tooltip: Flips the signal when the two mics face each other

name: Window
tooltip: Search range and reported latency; 0 is zero latency
notes: 0 (live): positive delay only; changes reported latency. Detect searches [-Window, +max(Window, 20 ms)], so it never proposes a delay this Window cannot apply

name: Detect
tooltip: Measures delay and polarity against the reference and applies them

name: Rotate
tooltip: Turns the low end where no single delay lines up two mics
notes: Degrees of phase shift at Below (unit list has no degree; editor shows the degree sign); two first-order TPT all-passes at f_c = Below / tan(Rotate/4), so 180 puts the corner on Below; 0 bypasses the stage with a 15 ms crossfade; magnitude flat, no latency; Detect proposes, Apply sets

name: Below
meaning: kick body / low end / low mids
tooltip: The frequency under which Rotate acts
notes: The frequency at which Rotate's angle is reached; the all-pass corner is derived from it and Rotate. Angles below 4*atan(Below/(0.45*fs)) are not reachable and snap to 0

name: Mode
tooltip: Static keeps the value; Track re-measures slowly

name: Hold
tooltip: Freezes the tracked value where it is

name: Listen
tooltip: Ref plays the sidechain, Sum plays both in mono

name: Trim
tooltip: Level of this track after alignment
